blocks.text: DETROIT— Jaylen Brown scored a season-high 30 points and made a key block in the final minute, helping the Philadelphia 76ers hold on for a 112-106 win over the Detroit Pistons in the NBA on Wednesday night. Joel Embiid had 26 points and 15 rebounds, and LeBron James added 13 points, 10 rebounds and eight assists as the Eastern Conference-leading Sixers improved to 8-1. Their lone loss came at home against Detroit. Philadelphia won despite an off night from Tyrese Maxey, held to a season-low 19 points on 5-of-16 shooting.
